title: Pandemin cat tnt
description: Pandemin Cat TNT is a simple, lightweight resource pack that replaces Minecraft’s default TNT texture with a clean, cat‑themed design. It keeps the original explosion behavior and sound while adding a fun visual twist that stays true to the vanilla style.
